sites.name: Chi Lang Historical Relic Area (Chi Lang Pass)
sites.event: A legendary landmark with glorious victories against northern invaders (Song, Yuan, Ming), where Lieu Thang was beheaded.

place.commune: Chi Lang Commune, Chi Lang Town

sites.name: Mau Son Peak
sites.event: A place chosen by the French as a resort since the early 20th century, famous for its temperate climate and winter frost and snow.

place.district: Loc Binh District (and Cao Loc District)

sites.name: Tam Thanh Pagoda - Tam Thanh Cave
sites.event: A famous scenic spot in the folk song 'Dong Dang has Ky Lua street / Has Lady To Thi, has Tam Thanh pagoda', which preserves many ancient cliff inscriptions.

sites.name: Mac Dynasty Citadel
sites.event: A military architectural relic reflecting the feudal conflict period (Le - Mac), built by taking advantage of the rugged mountainous terrain.

sites.name: To Thi Mountain (Lady To Thi)
sites.event: The mountain features a natural rock formation shaped like a woman holding her child, associated with the legend of Hon Vong Phu (the wife waiting for her husband until turning into stone).

sites.name: Dong Dang Mother Goddess Temple
sites.event: A place of worship for Buddha and the Mother Goddess of the Forest (Mau Thuong Ngan), the most famous spiritual destination in the northern border region.

sites.name: Bac Son Valley
sites.event: Famous for its golden ripe rice fields nestled among rolling limestone mountains, a popular landscape photography spot.

sites.name: Huu Nghi International Border Gate
sites.event: The starting point of National Highway 1A (Km 0), where milestone 1116 is located, marking sovereignty and Vietnam-China trade relations.

sites.name: Bac Son Uprising Relic
sites.event: The site of the first armed uprising led by the Indochinese Communist Party (in 1940).

sites.name: Ky Cung Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for Mandarin Tuan Tranh (Quan Lon Tuan Tranh) by the Ky Cung river wharf, associated with a unique river-bathing palanquin procession festival.

sites.name: Tham Khuyen - Tham Hai Cave
sites.event: An important archaeological site where fossils of ape-men (Homo erectus) and ancient animals were discovered.

sites.name: Dang Mo Waterfall
sites.event: A pristine waterfall flowing along rocky slopes, hidden in the old-growth forest.
